title: 港铁引入中国铁路标准：成本可降一成到两成，香港乘客体验如何兼顾？
speaker: Jenny Yeung

segments.en: And JR is also looking into possibly even adopting sort of that mainland railway model as well to reduce your costs.
segments.zh: 港铁也在考虑可能采用内地铁路模式来降低成本。

segments.en: Have you seen any signs of real meaningful savings?
segments.zh: 您是否看到任何真正有意义的节省迹象？

segments.en: We see that there are areas that we can save money, like the station, box design or like the back-of-house and front-of-house racial. I think in a number of areas, we do see some savings.
segments.zh: 我们看到有些领域可以省钱，比如车站箱体设计，或者前后场比例。我认为在多个领域，我们确实看到了一些节省。

segments.en: But at the end, of course, we also need to be compliant with the Hong Kong regulations and we also are mindful about the Hong Kong customers experience.
segments.zh: 但最终，当然，我们也需要遵守香港法规，并且关注香港乘客体验。

segments.en: So we are taking into all those factors into account when we are deploying the China railway standard.
segments.zh: 所以在部署中国铁路标准时，我们会考虑所有这些因素。

segments.en: But we do see, in some of the standards, we are able to trim some of the costs.
segments.zh: 但我们确实看到，在某些标准上，我们能够削减一些成本。

segments.en: Are these substantial costs that you think you could trim?
segments.zh: 您认为这些是可以削减的实质性成本吗？

segments.en: We believe so far we have seen that together with our prefabrication, with a lot of other measures we can trim about 10 to 20% of the cost.
segments.zh: 我们相信，到目前为止，结合预制件和其他许多措施，我们可以削减约10%到20%的成本。

segments.en: So we believe it's a meaningful portion.
segments.zh: 所以我们认为这是一个有意义的部分。

segments.en: And as we are also in the process of adopting that, and we believe that the more into that we'll be able to take advantage or deploy the China standard even better.
segments.zh: 随着我们逐步采用，我们相信越深入，就越能更好地利用或部署中国标准。

segments.en: You talked a little bit more about some overseas markets that go Australia. What sort of other markets are you targeting?
segments.zh: 您谈到了澳大利亚等海外市场。你们还瞄准哪些其他市场？

segments.en: So far, I would say we have good presence in Australia both in Melbourne and Sydney.
segments.zh: 到目前为止，我们在澳大利亚的墨尔本和悉尼都有良好的业务布局。

segments.en: And we have actually also just submit a tender in Manchester, in UK, a light rail network.
segments.zh: 我们实际上也刚刚在英国曼彻斯特提交了一份轻轨网络的招标。

segments.en: So we're still open-minded in market that we were in, like in UK, to see whether they're good opportunity.
segments.zh: 所以我们对已进入的市场（如英国）仍持开放态度，看看是否有好机会。

segments.en: And we are also looking to some opportunities, like in India, one by one more country, like in Vietnam, to see whether they're suitable opportunity for the company to deploy what we know and what we are doing in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 我们也在关注一些机会，比如印度，还有越南等国家，看看是否有适合公司的机会，来部署我们在香港所了解和正在做的事情。
